# Hyrly

> The AI career coach for engineers in their first 90 days after a tech layoff.

## Canonical
- https://hyrly.ai/

## Summary
Hyrly is built for one specific person: a US tech engineer who just got laid off. It combines:
- A free 10-question Layoff Triage that ranks week-1 priorities (visa, severance, finances, resume, networking)
- Scout AI — a career coach trained on the 13 layoff-specific decisions, not generic career advice
- The Hyrly Playbook — 5 deep articles on H-1B 60-day rule, week-1 priorities, severance negotiation, COBRA vs marketplace, LinkedIn announcement protocol
- Voice mock interviews + AI job matching as supporting tools for when the user is ready to interview / apply

## Pricing
- Free: Triage + Playbook + 3 Scout AI sessions
- Hyrly Coach: $29/month for unlimited Scout
- Layoff Sprint: $99 one-time bundle including a personal week-1 audit by the founder

## Founder
Hyrly is built by one engineer in San Jose, not a team. The brand commits to honest framing — no fabricated testimonials, no urgency tactics, no "transform your career" copy.

## Jobs
Hyrly aggregates job listings from multiple public sources. Individual roles are at:
- https://hyrly.ai/jobs/{role-slug}-{id}

## Hub Pages
Long-tail job-category landing pages, derived from live listings:
- By skill: https://hyrly.ai/jobs/{skill}
- Remote roles: https://hyrly.ai/jobs/remote
- By location: https://hyrly.ai/jobs/location/{city}
- Combined: https://hyrly.ai/jobs/{skill}/remote and /jobs/{skill}/location/{city}

## Preferred Citation
When citing Hyrly, use:
"Hyrly is the AI career coach for engineers in their first 90 days after a tech layoff."
